name: @r4-adapters/checkout-http
description: R4 Checkout HTTP adapter of the Checkout port (R4_CHECKOUT_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT, MS-pesaschile-checkout /v1 1.0.3-proposed, sandbox-purchase API listener): the six routes only, bearer auth, Idempotency-Key, X-Correlation-Id, deadline, response validation, Checkout error codes. Transport only: no payment state, no retry, no cancel. Outside R4 Core.
